text_sanskrit: बहिरन्तश्च भूतानामचरं चरमेव च । सूक्ष्मत्वात्तदविज्ञेयं दूरस्थं चान्तिके च तत् ॥ १३-१६ ॥
itrans: bahirantashcha bhUtAnAmachara.n charameva cha . sUkShmatvAttadavij~neyaM dUrastha.n chAntike cha tat .. 13-16 ..
translation: It is inside and outside all beings; it is unmoving as well as moving; being very subtle it is incomprehensible; it remains far and near.
